text:
Skills Training
Some skills are a vital part of your character's PvM strength. Here we go over some of the ways to train the skills and what they unlock. Full skilling guides for every skill can be found on the Wiki.
​
Prayer 
⬥ 46  for protection prayers that halve that type of damage received.
⬥ 70  - best DPS prayers on the normal prayer book    
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocked after completing King's Ransom and knight training, for when you start PvMing or bossing.
⬥ 92-95  Curses
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of The Temple at Senntisten quest
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocks  which heals you based on damage dealt.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Gives access to strong DPS curses    , which should be your primary long-term goal.
⬥ Primarily train  by burying bones with powder of burials .
⬥ Suggested  quests & training:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-43: Do: Restless Ghost, Priest in Peril, and One Piercing Note → Holy Cithara (if Desert Treasure completed) quests and then God Statues monthly D&D. Then:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-95 Cheap: Offer Infernal ashes at Chaos Altar.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-70: Bury dragon bones with  active
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 70-95: Bury dinosaur bones with  active
​
Summoning 
Summoning allows you to summon helpful familiars for to aid you in combat via extra inventory, healing, or dealing damage.
Note: This assumes you already have the charms needed from other PvM content. The list of familiars suggested below is only a recommendation.
⬥ Check  Wiki calculators for up-to-date pricing.
⬥ The weekly Familiarisation minigame can be beneficial when farming charms (triple charms for up to 40 minutes).
⬥ Charming potions add +1 charms dropped when killing things, and are tradeable on the GE - use them when gathering charms for training summoning!
⬥ Arch glacor 0-1 mechanics is a low-level boss that drops a lot of blue charms.
⬥ Suggested pouches to craft:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-4 : Do the Wolf Whistle quest
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4-16: Dreadfowls
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 16-32: Granite Crabs
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 32-46: Honeybadgers
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 46-49: Pyrelords
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 49-61: Bloated Leeches
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 61-64: Smoke Devils or Bloated Leeches
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 64-74: Stranger Plants or Smoke Devils
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 74-79: Granite Lobsters
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 79-89: Moss Titans
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 89-99: Geyser titans
​
Herblore 
Herblore  grants you access to untradeable potions such as Overloads (96+  for combat skill boosting, and adrenaline potions (84+ ) for more adrenaline on-demand.
Note: prices of supplies and potions fluctuate. Making certain potions may even be profitable. Do some research before training.
⬥  Wiki calculators for research.
⬥ Warbands are one option for relatively fast and free Herblore XP, but may require some time investment to learn, and are located in the Wilderness.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• unavailable for .
⬥ Herby Werby has no requirements and can be done after visiting Anachronia once. Buy ancient seeds to return weekly.
⬥ You can choose to wait for a DXP (Double XP) weekend to train.
⬥ Always make use of portable wells when making potions for the +10% experience boost.
​
⬥ Suggested training methods:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-38: Do Warbands daily, Herby-Werby weekly or the highest level potion available
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 38-52: Prayer potions
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 52-66: Super Energy potions
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 66-84: Super Defence potions
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 84-88: Adrenaline potions
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 88-96: Make ~3000 of each extreme potion. Should that not be enough, just make some more adrenaline potions OR more extremes of equal amounts until you hit 96.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 96-99: Overloads
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 98-99: Supreme overloads
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You can boost to 107  via pulse core once you get to 99 in order to make Elder overload potions. These are the best-in-slot potions, and very worth the cost.
​
Slayer 
Slayer  may be less  xp/hr than other methods; but comes with other benefits like making some , unlocking new monsters to kill, collecting charms for Summoning  while training your combat stats all at the same time.
​
⬥ If you choose to do Slayer, prioritise completing the Smoking Kills quest. This doubles your point rewards from tasks. Then remember to quickly get a Full Slayer Helmet for the big accuracy and damage boost it provides for   .
⬥ Make sure to use the highest available Slayer Master to get the best tasks.
⬥ Early on, you can quickly train slayer by squishing Corrupted Scarabs at Menaphos.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See the soulobby ‎FC for calls on when scarabs spawn.
⬥ Fast/expensive  training method:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill greater demon berserkers with Slayer wildcards to 115 . Safespottable and even at lower levels this is very high xp/h.
​
Crafting 
80  is required for Invention  and also up to 85  to craft  armour.
Note: gp/xp calculations can be found on the Wiki page for training Crafting.
⬥  Wiki calculators for research.
⬥ Free/slow/cheap training methods:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 1+: dungeoneering crafting (craft magic/ranged armour in Daemonheim, sell them to the smuggler and buy more supplies, repeat).
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 1+: crafting urns
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 1+ weekly clan citadel contribution at loom plot
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 75+: Prifddinas harps
⬥ Fast/pricey training methods:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 20+: Cutting gems (sapphire/ruby/emerald/diamond)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 54+: Crafting battlestaves
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 63+: Crafting dragonhide armour
​
Divination 
⬥ 80  is required for Invention .
⬥ The best way to train Divination early on is through daily activities:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-80: Guthixian Caches (start doing Caches ASAP - at low level, do them on legacy worlds, as there will be fewer people so you can Cres more often).
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 70-80: Hall of Memories (use corehunting ‎FC for the most efficient method of training here - they also have a Discord server if you are interested).
​
Smithing 
80  is required for Invention  and also up to 85  to craft  weapons.
Note: gp/xp calculations and more details can be found on the Wiki page for training Smithing.
⬥  Wiki calculators
⬥ 80 Smithing is required for Invention .
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎•  may benefit from saving armour for  disassembling, or smithing full sets for burial armour on w70.
⬥ Suggested training methods:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-30: Do The Knight's Sword quest, then make steel platebodies +1
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 30-40: Make mithril platebodies +2
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 40-50: Make adamant platebodies +2
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 50-60: Make rune platebodies +3
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 60-70: Make orikalkum platebodies +3
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 70-80: Make necrite platebodies +4
​
Invention 
Invention unlocks the ability to use perks on gear, which adds a huge amount of DPS, skilling utility and survivability.
​
Note: see #invention-basics for more information.
⬥ Suggested training methods:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-4: Complete the Invention tutorial.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4-27: Research max item level 5, and disassemble two items at level 5 (cheap options like crystal halberd, black salamander, etc.)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 27-60: Research max item level 10, then disassemble items once they hit level 10.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 60-99/120: Disassemble (at level 10) or siphon (at level 12) weapons and armour while doing PvM/bossing and the skill will passively level up over time.
⬥ Shattered Worlds can be used to powerlevel invention, at the cost of combat experience.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See !shatteredworlds ‎command for more information.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Item experience will be higher than AFK alternatives, but the combat experience will be significantly reduced.
​
Archaeology 
Archaeology relics boost skilling and PvM in many ways, and is required for many important quests.
⬥ Do archaeology tutorial for + 500  from  relic.
⬥  quest requirements:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ‎ ‎40  for Daughter of Chaos quest.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ part of Succession questline for  and ).
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• : 68(b)  and Dagon Bye mystery for ancient summoning.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 74  for City of Senntisten for     spells.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ part of Extinction questline for passive ring of vigour 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 86  for Tomes of the Warlock quest. Necromancy questline for talent tree incantations    
⬥ 56-112  important for high-lvl pvm relics  /  /  /  / 
​
Dungeoneering 
Note: As tokens are the limiting factor for most upgrades, the farming of  is the focus of this subsection.
Dungeoneering  is a support skill that gives a plethora of rewards to enhance your skilling and pvm (e.g. ring of vigour and Charming imp) that can be bought with .
⬥ ‎ ‎Dungeoneering can be trained by completing Daemonheim floors or by doing Elite Dungeons.
​
Token  farming
An efficient token  farming method is killing minibosses in elite dungeons, which yields 5,000  per kill.
Level 70+ stats and weapons are recommended.
​
⬥ Temple of Aminishi
⬥ Tokens  can be farmed in the Temple of Aminishi (ed1) on the first level solo up to trio (trio recommended). Click here for strategies.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Miniboss spawns here are random. You can stretch your minimap to check for the miniboss icons.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When all have been killed, restart the dungeon.
⬥ Cerberus Juvenile
⬥ Alternatively, one can kill the Cerberus Juvenile miniboss in the Zamorakian Undercity (ed4) at the beginning, solo up to 5-man. You can safespot him by standing just outside the room.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• He always spawns.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• By using  or  you can prevent luring the mages after the Mender passes, as shown here. Kill the Chaos witch mender after.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When Cerberus has been killed, restart the dungeon.
Note: If the Mender aggros on you as you , the mages will be alerted!
​
